description.value: Kariton Art Gallery + Boutique is a community art gallery operated by the Abbotsford Arts Council, housed in a detached heritage building on Ware Street in Abbotsford. It presents rotating exhibitions, workshops, open calls for artists, and a gift shop, and also hosts the Downie Wenjack Legacy Space dedicated to Indigenous reconciliation. The gallery is wheelchair accessible and sits in a quiet residential-scale neighbourhood, offering a cultural detour for cyclists touring the Fraser Valley.
